title: Front-door agent files carry the 2026-11-12 CEO rules
goal: A verification of both repositories against the CEO's vision found AGENTS.md complete and the hooks wired, but CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md, which agents load first, did not mention the 2026-11-12 tightenings: always on the latest remote (Mandate 74), always collaborative on the Susi Board (Mandate 76), keep the installed release updated (Mandate 48) and look before new code among Apache-2.0 work of every kind (Mandate 78). Add one 'every session' paragraph, identical in CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md. Text only; pairs with T-CLAUDECOMMFRONTDOOR-1.

reuse.searched: Both repositories: the rules already exist in AGENTS.md and the mandate documents; this repeats them in the two front-door files.
